title: Launch a landing page
promise: Go from an idea to a live one-page site with a sign-up form, using only free tiers.
audience: Makers testing an idea before building it

steps.title: Pick a palette
steps.why: Two or three colors chosen up front stop a page from looking assembled by committee; Coolors lets you lock the ones you like and keep pressing space.

steps.title: Choose a font pairing
steps.why: Google Fonts is free to use on the web and previews a pairing on your own sentence, which beats picking from a list.

steps.title: Find one strong photo
steps.why: Unsplash photos are free to use, and one good hero image does more than three mediocre ones.

steps.title: Build the sign-up form
steps.why: Tally is a form builder with a generous free tier and an embed code, so the form can live inside your page.

steps.title: Assemble and publish the page
steps.why: Carrd is built for one-page sites; the free tier publishes to a carrd.co address, and a custom domain needs a paid plan.
